notes: SCOPE: agent A2 — IS, segment, ops and non-GAAP blocks for Q1/13–Q4/16 and FY2013–FY2016 (no bs/cf). USD millions; shares in millions; per-share USD. Fiscal years are 52/53 weeks; FY2015 had 53 weeks (ended 3-Jan-2016) and Q4/15 had 14 weeks — Q4/15 figures are the 14-week columns of the Q4-2015 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428516000172/q4-2015earningsrelease.htm).

SOURCE RULE: quarterly/FY IS and segment tables taken from the earnings-release (8-K Ex.99.1) income statement and segment table, using the LATEST release that presents the period: 2013 quarters/FY from the 2014 releases' prior-year columns, 2014 from the 2015 releases, 2016 from the 2017 releases (Q4/16 and FY2016 from the Q4-2017 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428518000024/q4-2017earningsrelease.htm). Exception for 2015 — see PCT note. All values cross-checked against the 10-K quarterly-data notes (FY2013/2014/2015/2016/2017 10-Ks): exact match for every quarter (full IS and segment table for 2015/2016; sales/gross profit/NI/EPS for 2013–2014).

MISSING-CACHE RELEASES: the Q2-2014 release (8-K 0001094285-14-000158, q2-2014earningsrelease.htm) and also the Q3-2013 release (8-K 0001094285-13-000194, q3-2013earningsrelease.htm — the cache only held its Ex.10 exhibits) were downloaded into raw/er and appended to er_index.txt. 10-Qs 2013–2017 downloaded to raw/10q/<reportDate>_<doc>.

SEGMENT RECAST (Q2-2013): two business units moved from Aerospace & Defense Electronics to Instrumentation (Q2-2013 release footnote). Q1/13 is taken from the Q1-2014 release (recast): sales_inst 232.7 (orig. 221.2), sales_ade 163.1 (orig. 174.6), oi_inst 36.6 (orig. 35.0), oi_ade 20.2 (orig. 21.8). All later 2013 periods are on the new basis already.

PCT DISCONTINUED-OPS EPISODE: the Q2-2016, Q3-2016 and Q4-2016 releases (and Q2/Q3-2016 10-Qs) presented the Printed Circuit Technology business (A&DE; sold Jul-2016 for $9.3m, no gain/loss) as discontinued operations and recast 2015 comparatives (e.g. FY2015 sales 2,281.5, A&DE 576.8, OI 285.6; Q4/15 sales 594.7; disc ops FY2015 -2.5, FY2016 -2.0). The FY2016 10-K (filed 2-Mar-2017) reversed this ('sale and impact ... insignificant ... no longer presented within discontinued operations'), so the final basis for 2015 is the ORIGINAL 2015 presentation (Q2–Q4/15 from the 2015 releases, Q1/15 from the Q1-2016 release; FY2015 2,298.1 per Q4-2015 release = FY2016/FY2017 10-Ks) and 2016 is taken from the 2017 releases/10-K (PCT in continuing ops; FY2016 sales 2,149.9 vs 2,139.8 in the Q4-2016 release, OI 253.8 vs 256.9, A&DE sales 615.9 vs 605.8). The PCT-basis prior-year columns of the 2016 releases were deliberately NOT used. Hence no disc_ops key for 2015–2016.

ASU 2016-09 (early-adopted Q3-2016, retroactive to 1-Jan-2016): Q1/16 tax 15.6->14.9, NI 38.4->39.0, diluted shares 34.9->35.2, EPS 1.10->1.11; Q2/16 (also PCT) NI 45.7->46.9, diluted shares 35.0->35.3, EPS 1.33 (basic 1.36). Values recorded are the adjusted ones (Q1/Q2-2017 releases and FY2016 10-K quarterly note).

IS LINES: op_income = 'Income before other expense/income and income taxes' (2013 releases) / 'Operating income' (2014+). interest_exp_net = 'Interest and debt expense, net' (positive = expense). other_income = 'Other income/(expense), net' signed: notable items: Q4/13 +5.3 incl. $3.6m reversal of legal-settlement reserves; FY2014 +6.6 incl. $6.5m net gains on legal settlements; Q2/15 +3.4 incl. $3.0m legal-settlement gain; Q2/16 +17.2 incl. $17.9m gain on sale of a former operating facility (California); Q4/16 -4.4 incl. $5.5m e2v FX option-contract expense. income_cont = presented line where shown (Q4/13, FY2013 'Income from continuing operations including noncontrolling interest'); elsewhere = pretax - tax (no discontinued ops on the final basis). disc_ops = 0 for Q4/13 and FY2013 (shown as '—'; the 2.3 in the release relates to Q4/12). eps_diluted_cont only where presented (Q4/13, FY2013). No other_op lines (severance, impairments, environmental reserves are inside cost of sales/SG&A). nci = net_income - ni_teledyne (positive = NCI share of income; Teledyne presents NCI as an add-back, e.g. Q1/13 'Add: net loss attributable to NCI 0.6' -> nci -0.6); NCI relates to a non-wholly-owned subsidiary (the FY2015 10-K cash-flow note cites the 2015 purchase of the remaining interest in Optech); 0 from Q3/15. For 2016 the final presentation has no NCI line; nci = 0 (Q4-2016 release shows '—').

BASIC EPS/SHARES: from 10-Q income statements (latest = following year's 10-Q prior-year column) and FY 10-Ks; Q4 basic EPS from the 10-K quarterly note; Q4 basic share count not disclosed (omitted). Diluted shares/EPS from releases. Sum of quarterly EPS differs from FY by up to $0.01 (share-count effects): 2014 5.76 vs 5.75, 2015 5.45 vs 5.44, 2016 5.38 vs 5.37.

MEMO (release text): da = 'Depreciation and amortization expense for the quarter' (quarters sum exactly to FY CF D&A 91.1/94.3/90.3/87.3); capex = release capital expenditures (Q4/16 42.7 includes a $26.0m facility purchase under a 1031 like-kind exchange; 16.7 excluding it; FY2016 87.6 total / 61.6 excl.); sbc = STOCK OPTION EXPENSE only as disclosed in releases (FY totals 10.7/14.0/12.2/11.6 = 10-K CF 'stock option expense'; the FY2017 10-K CF relabels FY2016 'stock-based compensation' 16.2, which includes other share-based awards — not used, to keep quarters additive); pension_expense = total pension expense/(income) in the release (positive = expense): FY 17.5 / -1.3 / 3.0 / -2.2 per 10-K MD&A; Q1/15 -0.2 includes a $1.2m one-time gain from freezing the executive non-qualified plan. Release recasts adopted: Q1/14 sbc 2.7->2.6 (Q1-2015 release); Q1/16 sbc 3.3->3.4; 2016 D&A Q2/Q3/Q4 21.6/22.4/22.1 -> 21.7/22.8/21.7 (2017 releases). 2015 D&A/capex in PCT-basis 2016 releases (Q2 22.7/13.4, Q3 21.8/10.2, Q4 22.2/15.4) not used. amort_intangibles (annual only) = 10-K 'amortization expense ... for other acquired intangible assets' 31.5/32.0/30.6/28.3 (quarterly totals not disclosed). rd_company (annual) = 10-K 'Company-funded research and development and bid and proposal costs' (includes B&P) 167.0/166.9/163.7/167.7. interest_income (annual) from 10-K MD&A 0.5/0.2/0.1/0.3. depreciation not separately disclosed (omitted).

TAX ITEMS: ops.discrete_tax_benefit = net discrete tax benefit (+) / expense (-) stated in the release/10-K; ops.etr_ex_discrete = 'excluding the net discrete tax items, the effective tax rate would have been x%'. Quarter sums tie to FY discrete amounts (21.3/8.9/9.8/10.9). Q1/13 2.7 incl. retroactive 2012 R&D credit/Subpart F look-through (ATRA, enacted 2-Jan-2013). Q4/14 also had $5.6m R&D credits (Tax Increase Prevention Act) and Q4/15 $5.9m retroactive R&D credits (PATH Act) that the company did NOT count as discrete — hence low ex-discrete rates 21.8%/20.6%. Q2/14 ETR ex-discrete 28.1% from the Q2-2015 release (not in Q2-2014 release). Q2/16: -5.7 incl. $6.7m tax on the $17.9m facility gain; 26.2% excludes discrete items AND the facility gain (Q2-2017 release; Q2-2016 release gave -6.9 and no ex-discrete rate). 2016 values are from the 2017 releases (ASU 2016-09/PCT basis): Q1 +0.6/28.8% (orig. -0.1 expense/28.8%), Q3 +6.6/27.2% (orig. 27.5%; incl. $4.0m ASU 2016-09 benefit), Q4 +9.4/27.5% (orig. 27.6%; incl. $2.7m ASU 2016-09). FY: 27.1%/26.7%/28.1%/27.4% (2016 also excludes facility gain) per 10-Ks; FY2016 discrete includes $8.5m ASU 2016-09 benefit and -$6.7m tax on facility gain.

ACQUISITION SALES (ops.acq_sales): releases only state segment/product-line amounts, so the consolidated figure is taken from 10-Q MD&A 'Incremental revenue in the quarter from recent acquisitions' (Q1–Q3 2013–2015). Q4 = FY (10-K 'incremental increase in revenue from businesses acquired' 172.0/53.8/38.9/25.2) minus the 10-Q nine-month figure (148.9/40.1/35.7/15.2) — derived. 2016: Q1 2.3 (only amount stated: DI), Q2 = 6M 9.3 - 2.3 = 7.0, Q3 = 9M 15.2 - 6M 9.3 = 5.9 (derived). The company's YTD figures are NOT the sum of its quarterly figures (e.g. 2013 Q1–Q3 = 161.2 vs 9M 148.9), so quarters do not add to FY. Release statements for reference: Q1/13 marine $11.2m (RESON etc.), ETM +$43.4m LeCroy, DI $9.3m Optech, A&DE $1.0m VariSystems; Q2/13 marine $20.7m, ETM $46.4m LeCroy; Q3/13 marine $14.8m, env $2.2m CETAC; Q4/13 marine $18.1m (RESON, CDL), env $7.3m CETAC; Q1/14 marine $13.8m, env $6.5m; Q2/14 marine $3.6m (CDL), env $7.1m; Q3/14 marine $4.3m, env $5.9m; Q4/14 marine $10.6m (Bolt etc.); Q1/15 marine $12.1m (Bolt, Bowtech); Q2/15 marine $9.5m; Q3/15 marine $10.8m, DI $2.7m; Q4/15 DI $3.6m; Q1/16 DI $2.3m; Q2/16 ETM $5.5m, DI $2.9m; Q3/16 ETM $4.7m, DI $3.0m; Q4/16 ETM $5.2m, env $2.4m, DI $3.0m.

PRODUCT LINES: from 10-Q product-line tables (quarterly) and 10-K segment notes (FY); Q4 = FY - 9M (derived; ties to Q4 segment sales). SEGMENTS: segment OI labelled 'Operating profit and other segment income' (2013), 'Segment operating profit' (2014), 'Operating income' (2015+). In every period sum of segment OI - corporate expense = consolidated op_income (no other reconciling line, other_seg omitted). Annual segment D&A, capex and identifiable assets from the latest 10-K segment note (FY2013 from FY2015 10-K; FY2014 from FY2016 10-K; FY2015–16 from FY2017 10-K); segment totals tie to consolidated D&A/capex. FY2015 identifiable assets 2,717.1 / corporate 198.8 per FY2016–17 10-Ks (FY2015 10-K showed 2,718.5 / 200.2, before debt-issuance-cost reclass). Corporate assets include prepaid pension asset (222.0 / 86.3 / 111.0 / 88.5 for 2013–2016 per latest 10-Ks; FY2015 10-K showed 77.2).

PRETAX SEVERANCE/FACILITY CHARGES (not adjusted by the company in this period; included in GAAP OI): 2013 Q1–Q4 2.2/2.2/14.3/5.3 (incl. $5.3m environmental reserve in Q3) per FY2013 10-K quarterly note; FY2014 4.4, FY2015 8.4, FY2016 17.3 (by segment 2016: inst 10.6, DI 2.0, A&DE 4.6, ES 0.1) per FY2016/2017 10-K segment notes (the Q4-2016 release cited 14.1 for 2016 incl. asset impairment). Q3/14 1.7, Q3/15 3.1 per releases. Q4/13 DI included a $1.2m asset impairment.

NON-GAAP: no adjusted EPS/NI/OI was published in any release from Q1-2013 through Q3-2016 (checked every release; only free cash flow and ex-discrete tax rates). The Q4-2016 release (2-Feb-2017, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428517000025/q4-2016earningsrelease.htm) introduced 'fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.65, a non-GAAP measure', excluding pretax e2v transaction charges of $7.9m ($0.16/share) from GAAP continuing-ops EPS of $1.49 (PCT basis). The latest presentation (Q4-2017 release reconciliation) restates Q4/16 as GAAP diluted EPS 1.48 + 0.04 (e2v transaction costs, $1.9m in SG&A/corporate) + 0.01 (bridge facility commitment fees, $0.5m in interest) + 0.11 (FX option contract to hedge e2v price, $5.5m other expense) = 1.64, and FY2016 5.37 -> 5.53; adjusted OI Q4/16 70.5 -> 72.4, FY2016 253.8 -> 255.7 (only the $1.9m is inside OI). Per-share items are published net of tax ('net of income taxes of $0.06 per diluted share based on a 27.5% income tax rate'); item 'value' = pretax $m from the IS footnote, 'value_eps' = published AFTER-TAX per-share amount (these sum to the EPS bridge 0.16); the TAX item (value only, -2.2) is DERIVED (7.9 x 27.5%) so that the $ values bridge pretax->after-tax; it has no value_eps to avoid double counting. No $ adjusted NI was published (implied ~58.7 Q4/16, ~196.6 FY2016) so adj_ni_published is omitted. Q1–Q3/16: the 2017 releases show adjusted OI and adjusted EPS equal to GAAP (no adjustments) as comparatives — recorded with empty item lists. adj_om_published not published.

OPS (annual, 10-K): sales_us_gov (and by segment sales_us_gov_<seg>) 630.2/607.9/598.0/577.7; sales_intl_pct = 'sales to international customers' share (customer location) 44%/45%/44%/43%; rev_us/rev_canada/rev_uk/rev_france/rev_other = sales by country of ORIGIN from the segment note (France split out only in the FY2017 10-K, used for 2015–16); funded_backlog = 'total backlog of confirmed orders' at year end 941.2/944.6/802.8/916.4; employees = total workforce 9,600/9,800/9,200/8,970. fcf_published = release free cash flow (CFO - capex; quarters tie to FY; 2016 from Q1–Q4-2017 releases: 54.9/67.3/83.6/23.6, FY 229.4 — Q4/16 after the $26.0m facility purchase; Q4-2016 release had 21.2/228.6 on PCT basis; FY2014 244.4 per Q4-2015 release vs 240.2 originally). Q1/13 FCF -73.0 reflects an $83.0m voluntary pension contribution.

CHECKS: IS arithmetic ties for every period (sales-COGS-SG&A=OI; OI-interest+other=pretax; pretax-tax=income_cont; +disc=NI; NI/diluted shares ~ EPS). Segment sales sum to net sales and segment OI - corporate = OI in all periods. Quarterly sums equal FY for all IS lines, segment lines, product lines, da, capex, sbc, pension, discrete tax and FCF (acq_sales excepted, see above). XBRL companyfacts: net sales, NI, OI, diluted/basic EPS agree for all 20 periods where tagged (114 checks); the only 'mismatches' were IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit facts that are discrete-tax amounts, not the provision.
